blurb: Guests receive various massage and bodywork treatments including Swedish, deep tissue, shiatsu, reiki, and ayurvedic therapies. Services also include face and foot care treatments such as reflexology and Japanese foot baths. The spa uses natural oils, herbs, and aromas to promote balance and relaxation.
